description: Turn on Scale to Frame Size for clip project items (Clip > Video Options > Scale to Frame Size): clips placed from them afterwards are resampled to the sequence frame size. Clips already in a sequence are not changed; fit_clips_to_frame sets their scale. One undo step

item.description: A project item: its id (from list_project_items), its bin path such as "Footage/Interviews/a.mov", or its name when that is unique

name.description: Item name, when only one item has it

path.description: Bin path, "/"-separated, from the project root

items.description: Several clip project items instead of item
